breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the instruction to replace the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load. Instead, it specifies using the integration method with the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L − x), which matches the ground truth approach. The erroneous claim that the concentrated load substitution is 'exact' is entirely absent from the generated specification.
